lessons: Recurring bug classes need structural fixes. S120/S121/S122/S125/S126 are 5 different proximate causes of one symptom (login hang). Audit #6 (passkeys) + #7 (synthetic canary) retire the class entirely.

Iframe reparenting ≠ moving a div. Cross-origin iframes lose their parent contentWindow/origin handshake when their host node is appendChild'd elsewhere. Render into the destination from the start; never relocate.
Skill flow /audit → /implement → /closeout reduces decision overhead. One founder direction-burst, one ranked plan, bounded ship, ledger captures deferrals for next pass.

'exit 0 silent push failure' with 'cannot lock ref: is at X but expected Y' (X being our HEAD) is a server-side race meaning the prior push already landed — verify with git fetch + git log origin/main before retrying.
